## What is still open

- Rollback rehearsal on a fresh clone is still to be done on Thursday 19/11: after switchover the old instance diverges, so you need to measure how long a rollback takes and what data is lost. [1][3]
- Merge #321 and update the runbook (and the Notion page) to the confirmed date — Maya has now cleared the merge condition. [3][8]
- Give Lior 30 minutes' notice before the switchover so he can pause the ingest consumers cleanly. [9]
- Daniel is on call for the API side on Sunday and wants you to ping him when the switchover starts. [7]

## What changed

- The cutover window moved from Saturday 21/11 to **Sunday 22/11, 02:00–04:00 UTC**, because Fernhill's month-end batch runs Saturday night until ~06:00 UTC; Maya has informed the CSMs. [8]
- Maya approved #321, with the caveat that the runbook date had to be confirmed first. [3]
- Renovate opened #320 to bump the AWS provider from 5.80 to 5.82 (automerge off). [4]

## What you did

- Prepared the prod PG15→PG17 cutover: RDS blue/green Terraform with the read replica following the deployment instead of being destroyed, plus `runbooks/pg17-cutover.md`, all in PR #321. [1]
- Validated it on a snapshot clone: green ready in 52 minutes, replication lag under 1s, **74 seconds of write unavailability** at switchover, API pods reconnected via pgbouncer without restarts, and no row-count mismatch on the 20 biggest tables; the clone was then torn down to stop costs. [1]
